title: Generate All Paths with Variable Length Jumps
problemStatement: Given an N × M grid, generate all possible paths from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell. From any cell, you may move: Horizontally right by any positive number of cells (Hk) Vertically down by any positive number of cells (Vk) Diagonally down-right by any positive number of cells (Dk) where k denotes the jump length. Print all valid paths in lexicographical order.
